scope: The two already paid native tests and two actual kernel columns, with every old row, cut and C/E branch retained.
interpretation: Finite auxiliary full type-five homogeneous incidence has rank five and a one-dimensional kernel. Actual J2 is a+b and the original regular-source scale is a. A characteristic-zero construction must use the fixed five-column determinant plus the previously proved actual-parameter density lemma; finite compatibility alone is not a proof.
